hard_graph_base: alias-only deterministic graph; field-path ablation produced no additional unique direct accepts

semantic_source.role: seed an already-authorized Tool->Endpoint->Operation path only

additional_development_guard.note: This guard only makes development selection more conservative; it does not relax preregistered calibration or blind gates.

selection_rule: discard any threshold pair failing a hard gate or direct-accept precision guard
maximize total hard+semantic graph resolution rate among remaining candidates
tie-break by higher harmonic mean of supported accuracy and near-domain rejection

efficiency_validation.reason: Initial hard-graph sequential benchmark exposed warm-cache/order bias.

forbidden: no tuning on v5 calibration, v12, consumed v13, retired v14, fresh calibration, or v15
no semantic seed may create a route absent from the compiled registered graph
no semantic seed may directly reject a route
do not change threshold grid after semantic geometry is observed
